about: Twenty moments from story-pictures.json, each to be drawn three ways that differ only in image 1 (evals/paired.ts): the floor-plan mock-up, as today's routing draws a moment but without earlier moments (mockup); the previous picture the same run drew, edited (edit); and nothing (free). After image 1 every arm attaches the same sketches of who and what is in view and the same in-between pictures today's plan attaches, in the same order. Spread over the kinds of moment the dreams have; every one has an earlier drawn moment in its run to edit, and today's plan gives every one a camera and a mock-up. move is the camera's move from that previous picture (same setup, same side, other side, another place, dream jump), as today's continuity plan reads it, so results can be reported by camera move. The verdicts in the reasons are the person's own (human in story-pictures.json) on the picture the run drew. The Flooded Library (library-2) is left out: its rowing boat was never sketched, so the engine refuses any picture with the boat in it, and its water moments have no floor-plan camera.

rows.reason: Tomas as a boy beside the dreamer in the tiny lift, through their eyes: a person whose age has changed, carried in every arm by its in-between pictures (his age, his school uniform). Judged right.
An empty orchard where Tomas was: a view of a place with nobody in it, judged wrong (he is still there, half invisible, when he should be gone).
The dreamer's own hand opening the red door on warm light: a point-of-view action on a thing standing alone in a field.
The paper boat in the dreamer's hands, through their eyes, the father's table behind, edited from a picture of another place. Judged right.

The open suitcase of letters held out toward the dreamer: a held thing whose look has changed (opened), carried in every arm by its in-between picture. Judged wrong on continuity (someone suddenly sitting on the chair, against the picture before).
The hand holding the brass key, judged right; today's floor plan renders a different mock-up from the run's.
The paper boat held up in the round room, judged wrong (the tractor inside the room); today's mock-up differs from the run's.
Two people small in a snowy nowhere walking to a red door standing alone: a wide outdoor shot with a lot of empty space.

The yellow boat between the flooded shelves with a whale under it, inside the reading room: a wide shot of three sketched things at very different sizes, judged wrong (the whale pasted in, the composition poor).
The boat risen to the high round window over the drowned city, inside the reading room: height in a wide shot, judged wrong (the camera never moved from the pictures before, and the water was gone).
Books lifting off the shelves like birds as the water comes in: the library's change of state, its in-between picture in every arm. Judged partly right (no water yet).
The water risen over the desks, the dreamer standing in it: the second step of the same change, both in-between pictures in every arm. Judged right.

The two sisters stopping at the old man's fish stall in the night market: three sketched people and the fish, no crowd in its words (the crowd is the moment before). Judged partly right (the dreamer not looking toward the fish).
A classroom of still, faceless students, judged partly right (it could be drawn better); the last picture drawn before it is of another place, the corridor.
Inside the tractor cab from behind, the grass bending outside: a vehicle seen from within, after a picture of its other side, judged partly right (the view hardly changed from that picture).

The grandfather with the suitcase on his knees in the old train at night, snow outside: seated people in a railway carriage, judged wrong on continuity (everything as in the picture before, though the view had changed).
The dream's jump into the tractor beside a stranger, judged right: an edit across a jump to another place.
The dog looking back at the dreamer on the beach, judged right: an animal that must match its sketch.
The white horse lowering its nose to the dreamer's hand, through their eyes, judged right.
The grandfather handing the suitcase to the dreamer before the red door: two people and a handed-over thing, facing each other.
